review_conclusion: ApplyRefund checks cancelled/multi status and caps cumulative refunds against order Total less prior RefundAmount; it does not require IsPaid or a collected-tender amount. The aggregate mutates state only. RefundOrderHandler separately authorizes, checks pooled source-account balance, serializes per-order updates and transactionally records refund/movement/order/audit, but those controls do not prove this order was collected. Checkout permits COD/pending electronic deferred states; electronic confirmation settles separately.
test_conclusion: RefundVerticalSliceTests contains paid cash full/partial/clamped/replay/concurrency and authorization cases; no unpaid COD or pending electronic refund case was found in the inspected suite. Tests were read, not run.
scope: This stable callable only; does not certify the 327-file financial workstream or whole-file status.
finding_disposition: Corroborates existing FIN-003; no duplicate finding.
limitations: Whether COD can be refunded before collection is an owner policy question.
No deployment/live database/runtime result or realized loss is established.
